cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.after-fight: Good job, pal. Thanks for getting us out of this mess. We'll be on our way now.
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.already-killed-enforcers: No need. I already took care of everypony outside. Just came to tell you the way is clear.
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.bibin-start-will-be-back: I still have to figure it out. I'll be back soon.
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.entry: How nice of you to come one by one. Let's make an example out of you, show your little friends what will soon happen to them.
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.entry-provocative-exit: One of me is more than enough to take care of y'all, wimp. Let's get to it.
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.leave-bubble: Alright, ponies ! We're moving out ! Let's go !
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.on-bibin-restart: What now ? Anything new, or do I have to get out and take care of it all by myself ?
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.on-bibin-start:
Really ? He sent you ? That's it ? What an ass… I was expecting some firepower.
So what, do you have some kind of plan to get us out of here ?
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.on-enforcers-killed:
She makes a sign towards of her goons. They check the window, the doors, and report no live enforcers.

Damn. You're efficient. Thanks for the help, pal.
cristal-den/bibins/siege-herd-leader.start-bibin-quest: Wait. Bibin sent me. I'm here to help.
